description: Contains the PdfExtGStateTable class which manages external graphic state objects within a PDF document, including methods to retrieve or create stroke and non-stroke graphics states with specified alpha transparency.

classes.name: PdfExtGStateTable
classes.description: Manages a collection of external graphic state objects, providing methods to retrieve or create them based on alpha transparency and overprint settings.

methods.name: PdfExtGStateTable.PdfExtGStateTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table for a specific PDF document.

methods.name: PdfExtGStateTable.GetExtGStateStroke
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a PdfExtGState with specific stroke alpha transparency and overprint setting.

methods.name: PdfExtGStateTable.GetExtGStateNonStroke
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a PdfExtGState with specific non-stroke alpha transparency and overprint setting.
